name: repo-health
description: Measure how well an existing code repository is guarded and where it needs work, then write a ranked Markdown report of recommendations. Checks lint, types, static analysis, tests, coverage, CI, setup, docs, dependencies, file sizes and git hotspots for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, Java, Go and Kotlin, and gives each dimension a level from absent to effective. Cheap checks run at once; running tools or tests and LLM code reading run only after you agree. Reports only; it changes no project file.
